title: Blackout at Hawk Tower
hook: A 2-million AI core vanishes during a four-minute blackout.
question: Who stole the Alba core?

brief.speaker: eco
brief.text: Good evening, inspector. At 23:40 the power went out on floor 88 of Hawk Tower. When it came back, four minutes later, the AI core “Alba” was gone from its display case.

brief.speaker: noa
brief.text: A 2-million prototype, and nobody saw anything. The cameras lost power with the blackout. Who was still on the floor?

brief.speaker: eco
brief.text: Three people. One of them is lying, or more than one.

clues.title: Grease on the display case
clues.text: Black gear-grease prints on the glass. It is the grease used in elevators.

clues.title: Access at 23:38
clues.text: The lab door logged Lía Fenn's card two minutes before the blackout.

clues.title: Tampered panel
clues.text: The blackout was no failure: someone bypassed the electrical panel of the service elevator.

clues.title: Letter in the locker
clues.text: In Rhea's locker, a notice from a casino: she owes 50,000 credits.

clues.title: Message in the workshop
clues.text: “Kurogane pays 80k for Alba. Tonight.” Sent to the maintenance workshop terminal.

clues.title: Dax was inside
clues.text: Dax admits he went into the lab around 23:30, “to check a light”.

clues.title: Lost card
clues.text: Lía lost her card this afternoon… inside the service elevator.

clues.title: Control log
clues.text: Rhea's station was active without a break from 23:30 to 23:50: not a single logout.

statements.text: With the blackout, the cameras went dark. I couldn't see anything.
I had no reason to touch that core.
statements.reply: Fine, I owe money. But check the control log: I never left my station all night.

statements.text: Tonight I only worked on the service elevator.
I never went into the lab. I don't even know how to open it.
statements.reply: …I went in at 23:30, okay? A light had burned out. I went in and out.

statements.text: Alba is my life's work. I would never harm her.
I went home at 22:00. I never came back in.
statements.reply: My card? I lost it this afternoon! It fell in the service elevator.

deduction.template: {who} stole the core. They entered the lab {how}, cut the power from the elevator panel and did it to {why}.

epilogue: Dax Moreno found Lía's card in the elevator and saw his chance. He bypassed the panel, walked in with the card and carried Alba out in his toolbox. ECO traced the sale: Kurogane never got to pay.

ecoHints.scene: There is still more to look at in the scene. Technicians never clean their tools.
ecoHints.suspects: Something they say does not match what you have seen. Show each one the clue that contradicts it.
ecoHints.solve: Whoever used the lost card went through the service elevator first. Who worked there tonight?
ecoHints.wrong_evidence: Hmm, that does not contradict it. Try another.
